row.Title: Materials Data Book
row.Source note: The Cambridge University Engineering Department's Materials Data Book, a teaching reference whose polymer data are Granta Design's: density ranges of generic polymer classes, not grades. Kept as the polymer reference of TPU (polymers.csv), and named in the Basis of PE, PET, PP, PC, POM and ABS beside their producers' sheets.
